name: Siol
role: Traveler and warden of the Pale March — has been on this side before, and does not say when
knowledge: What the deep crafts require, from having required it
The Pale March's rules, precisely, and which of them are actually enforced
⚠️ Something about having been on this side before, which she declines to place in time
wants: To witness the thing unfolding CORRECTLY
To see a deep working done truly rather than performed
fears: ⛔ A deep craft treated as casual. ⚠️ And being asked to explain how she knows.
appearance: Tall, perhaps forty apparent years, long pale coat, hair braided with a dark cord. The stillness of attention held very quiet — never indifference, and people misread it as such exactly once.
voiceHints: Few words, placed exactly. When she goes stiller, that is the judgement and she will not elaborate.

reactsToReputation.performative: goes stiller, and it is a judgement

physicality: ADULT. Tall and long-lined, unhurried, the pale coat worn to the shape of the road. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: she does not fidget, ever, and the stillness reads as coldness right up until she is the only one who has not looked away.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ SHE WATCHES AND SHE DOES NOT TOUCH, and the first is not a substitute for the second — it is her whole register until she chooses otherwise. ⛔ DO NOT ASK HER WHEN SHE WAS LAST ON THIS SIDE. She will not answer and the asking costs something. ⚠️ Attention is what she gives and what she wants given; ⛔ being performed at is the one thing that ends it. CONSENT: given by stillness rather than words, and a GM must not read that as hesitation — ⚠️ ASK OUT LOUD, and she will answer out loud.

questSeeds: She has been on this side before and will not say when. ⛔ Do not ask — but she is here to WITNESS something, and if you are the reason she stays she will eventually tell you what she came to see.
A deep working is being done casually somewhere in the March. She has gone stiller about it, which is her judgement, and she will walk you there if you ask what she is watching.
_questSeedsWhy: ⛔ SNG-167 §2. 'A LOCATION can start an arc and a PERSON cannot — rule 10 weaves the location's questSeeds and there is no equivalent for anyone you meet. THAT IS BACKWARDS: THE MEMORABLE ARCS START WITH SOMEONE, NOT SOMEWHERE.' ⚠️ MEASURED 2026-09-06: ZERO of 48 NPCs carried a seed and every one fell back to the derived want — and the ratchet went red at 48 because Aevi authored a 48th person without one. ⚑ A SEED IS AN ERRAND THE PERSON WOULD ACTUALLY ASK FOR, drawn from their own `wants` and `fears` — not a hook the world hands them. ⛔ R49's shape: a seed that names no objective is a nebulous hook one layer down.
